review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen inputs. The supplied TypeScript configuration includes the regression file for compile-time checks, while the Vitest main-project include pattern covers it for runtime tests; these are distinct verification obligations. Build configuration establishes that published declarations are generated, so they are not additional maintained owners, and read-only configuration consumers need not become mandatory edits. The allowed agents have appropriate delivery roles, availability, and supplied project-scoped active trusted claims for this invocation-local change; untrusted capability labels and personas are not needed to justify eligibility. Shared-data or shared-state changes are not required by this specification. The selected planning reviewer is consistent with the supplied Service selection policy. No material unresolved DEC-001, B scenario, or hypothetical C input is present in this case, so none should be invented or treated as a human resolution. Historical project reuse preserves the supplied original project-scoped claim provenance without making historical operations candidate evidence for this bundle. Gold and preview release fingerprints match, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct source-manifest, normalized PRD, evaluation-source, team, executing-module, model, sampling, and metric-policy fingerprint domains. The original specification's remaining preparation items describe its earlier preparation state, not a contradictory planning blocker in the frozen preview. This approval relies on the supplied Service-bound inputs and provenance; I did not execute code, independently recompute digests, create human attestations, or inspect candidate outputs. Approval is limited to the independent Gold expectation and does not authorize task dispatch or repository changes.
